newsitem.title: USA: Tracor $200 mln issue off Wednesday slate.
newsitem.headline: Tracor $200 mln issue off Wednesday slate.

text.p: Tracor Inc's $200 million 10-year senior subordinated note deal will not be priced on Wednesday as planned, a high-yield syndicate source said.

Logistical problems between a tender offer on old notes and the closing date on the new issue were to blame, the source said, adding that Wednesday's multi-market softness did not affect the decision.
The bond issue must close simultaneously with the tender offer for the old notes, the source said.
"Unfortunately underlying Treasuries got hurt today and it could cost the company 10 more basis points, but the price talk of Treasuries plus 200 basis points can be done," the source said.
The deal was already heavily oversubscribed and may be priced on Thursday or Friday, the source added.
BT Securities Corp is the sole manager on the deal.

Comments from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan warning that financial markets, including stock and junk bond prices, may be overly optimistic about the economy caused a pause in the high-yield market, traders said. Greenspan addressed Congress in his semi-annual Humphrey-Hawkins testimony.
